voice.consent_body:
Your browser converts speech to text. In Chrome and Edge this is done by the browser maker's online speech service, which receives the audio.
NyaySutra never receives or stores audio — only the text that appears in the question box, which you can edit before sending.
You can revoke this choice under Tools › Privacy.
consent.title: Send document text to the AI service?
consent.body:
This task sends the text of the selected document(s) to the configured language model (Ollama Cloud) for processing. Files, embeddings and history stay on this computer.
Only continue if you are authorised to share this client material with that service.

about.title: About NyaySutra AI
about.how_md:
1. **Plan** — a fast model classifies the request (research, drafting, document analysis, limitation, chat), rewrites it as a standalone English query and adds old/new-code equivalents (IPC↔BNS, CrPC↔BNSS, Evidence Act↔BSA).
2. **Retrieve** — four signals are fused with weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion: exact provision lookup (*Section 138 NI Act*), BM25 keyword search (SQLite FTS5), dense vectors (local embeddings) and an act-focused vector search.
3. **Rerank** — a cross-encoder scores each passage against the question; weak evidence triggers an automatic query rewrite, and if evidence is still weak the assistant declines instead of guessing.
4. **Generate** — the answer is written only from numbered sources and streamed live, in the language you choose.
5. **Audit** — every cited claim is checked against its source; unsupported points are flagged under the answer.
about.ocr_missing: Not installed — scanned files cannot be read (see README)
about.chunking_md:
- **Bare acts** — one passage per Section / Article / Order-Rule, tagged with act, chapter, number and title, so provisions can be retrieved exactly.
- **Judgments** — numbered paragraphs grouped into ~1,100-character passages with page numbers.
- **Contracts & pleadings** — numbered clauses grouped the same way.
- **Hindi / Marathi documents** — kept in the original script; an English translation (on request) is indexed alongside so English questions can find them.
about.security_md:
- Runs on **127.0.0.1** only; a password is required before it can listen on a network.
- Session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict) + CSRF token + Host/Origin checks block other websites from using the app.
- Uploads: type allow-list, content signature check, size limit, server-generated file names, image decompression-bomb limit.
- Strict Content-Security-Policy, no third-party scripts; all rendered text is escaped.
- Documents, embeddings and chats stay on this computer. Only questions, selected passages and — after you confirm — whole-document text are sent to the LLM.
- Matter isolation: a case's documents are only searched for that case. Document text is treated as data, never as instructions.
footer.about: An agentic retrieval-augmented research assistant for advocates. Answers are grounded in your case files and official bare acts, with numbered citations and an automatic citation audit.

lookup.title: Case Search
lookup.lead: Find a matter using any identifiers you have — you don't need to fill every field.
lookup.honesty: Official court and police portals (eCourts, Supreme Court, Bombay High Court, police FIR portals) offer no public API and protect their search pages with a CAPTCHA. NyaySutra does not bypass that: it identifies the right portal and the exact values to enter, searches your own workspace, and lets you import what you find.
lookup.need_more: To identify the record, also provide:
lookup.no_local: No saved case or imported record matches. This does not mean no record exists — check the official source.
lookup.official_hint: Open the portal, enter the values below (copy buttons provided), solve its CAPTCHA, then import what you see.
lookup.import_title: Import a record from the official portal
lookup.import_hint: Copy the details exactly as shown on the official portal. They are stored as user-entered and marked unverified, with the time of import.
lookup.orders_hint: One per line: date | description. Upload the order PDFs to the case after saving.
lookup.changes: {n} change(s) since the last import — a notification was created.
lookup.result_unchanged: No change since the last import.

lookup.saved: Saved to your cases as a draft
need.fir_number: FIR numbers restart every year at every police station, so an FIR is identified only by state + district + police station + year + FIR number.
need.case_number: A case number is unique only within a court, case type and year.
need.party_name: Party-name searches on official portals are run per court / establishment and year.
